adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the previous logic did `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` and on failure only `console.error(...)` (logging zodError + MS response) while continuing with the existing `o365AuthCredentials` and updating Prisma. The refactor replaces this with `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`, whose implementation throws `new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` when `safeParse` fails, and the prior console diagnostics are removed. Also, because `parseRefreshTokenResponse` throws on failure, downstream checks like `tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data` in Office365 are effectively dead/pointless (success will always be true if it returns). The finding’s claims about stricter failure behavior and loss of logging are directly supported by the diff; the impact on “live booking” is plausible but not provable solely from this diff.
